positions.title: Cyber Risk Intern
positions.description:
•	Engaged with a team to manage, assess, and track high priority cybersecurity projects across a large federal healthcare agency.
•	Wrote attributes, similar to Excel Macros, to allow streamlined use of an expected completion percentage calculator. Consolidated a tedious and lengthy process into one MS Project Plan document.
•	Wrote a Python script to automate a process that transferred data from a PowerPoint to an exhaustive and organized Excel sheet, back to a PowerPoint, and out to stakeholders and leadership. The script saved management hours every week and eliminated a repetitive, yet crucial process.
•	Synthesized a convoluted 40+ page document to a shorter more exhaustive and detailed, yet clear, that allowed new cybersecurity projects to be added to the large federal healthcare agency’s dashboard. Alleviated verbose one-on-one’s with agency’s leadership due to the complex nature of the original document.
•	Presented an account-wide forum on the relation between the National Institute of Standards and Technology’s Cybersecurity Framework and the federal healthcare agency’s cybersecurity posture.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Teaching Assistant—help student groups, approximately 40 students total, conduct similar development, design, calculations, presentations, troubleshooting, and production with their own vehicle. Lead class discussions, lecture, and lab times. (Fall 2018, Spring 2019)
